1	# Frade — Engineering Agent Contract
     2	
     3	## Purpose
     4	
     5	This file defines repository-wide engineering rules for AI coding agents working on Frade.
     6	
     7	These rules are mandatory.
     8	
     9	Subsystem-specific rules may exist in nested `AGENTS.md` files and may impose stricter constraints.
    10	
    11	---
    12	
    13	## 1. Development Method
    14	
    15	Frade uses:
    16	
    17	```text
    18	SDD / OpenSpec
    19	    ↓
    20	BDD
    21	    ↓
    22	TDD
    23	    ↓
    24	Implementation
    25	    ↓
    26	Verification
    27	    ↓
    28	Architecture Gate
    29	    ↓
    30	Archive
    31	```
    32	
    33	Implementation follows specification.
    34	
    35	Specification must not be silently changed to match implementation.
    36	
    37	Tests must not be weakened to make implementation pass.
    38	
    39	---
    40	
    41	## 2. OpenSpec Is the Change Authority
    42	
    43	For substantial product or architecture work:
    44	
    45	1. identify the active OpenSpec change;
    46	2. read its proposal/spec/design/tasks;
    47	3. validate the change before implementation;
    48	4. implement only the active scope;
    49	5. run required tests;
    50	6. run OpenSpec verification;
    51	7. pass the Architecture Gate;
    52	8. only then archive the change.
    53	
    54	Do not implement a later dependent change before the previous change has passed its gate.
    55	
    56	---
    57	
    58	## 3. STOP Conditions
    59	
    60	Stop progression whenever any of the following is true:
    61	
    62	```text
    63	required test fails
    64	typecheck fails in affected code
    65	OpenSpec validation fails
    66	OpenSpec verification has a correctness blocker
    67	architecture invariant fails
    68	architecture gate fails
    69	reference parity fails
    70	a specification conflict exists
    71	a previously fixed regression reappears
    72	```
    73	
    74	Resolve the blocker before moving to the next phase.
    75	
    76	---
    77	
    78	## 4. No Patch-Loop Rule
    79	
    80	After two unsuccessful fixes of the same deterministic defect:
    81	
    82	```text
    83	STOP PATCHING
    84	```
    85	
    86	Before another production-code modification, perform root-cause analysis.
    87	
    88	Classify the failure as:
    89	
    90	```text
    91	DOMAIN_MODEL
    92	INVARIANT
    93	ALGORITHM
    94	ABSTRACTION_BOUNDARY
    95	STATE_TRANSITION
    96	TEST
    97	SPEC_CONFLICT
    98	INTEGRATION
    99	ENVIRONMENT
   100	```
   101	
   102	Do not continue making local symptom-oriented fixes.
   103	
   104	---
   105	
   106	## 5. Regression-First Rule
   107	
   108	For a reproduced defect use:
   109	
   110	```text
   111	DEFECT
   112	 ↓
   113	DETERMINISTIC REPRODUCTION
   114	 ↓
   115	FAILING TEST / FIXTURE
   116	 ↓
   117	ROOT CAUSE
   118	 ↓
   119	IMPLEMENTATION FIX
   120	 ↓
   121	TARGETED TEST
   122	 ↓
   123	FULL REGRESSION SUITE
   124	```
   125	
   126	Do not fix production code first and add a regression test afterwards unless reproduction before the fix is technically impossible and explicitly documented.
   127	
   128	---
   129	
   130	## 6. Test Integrity
   131	
   132	Do not make tests pass by weakening them.
   133	
   134	Forbidden without an explicit specification decision:
   135	
   136	```text
   137	test.skip
   138	it.skip
   139	describe.skip
   140	
   141	test.only
   142	it.only
   143	describe.only
   144	
   145	removing meaningful assertions
   146	loosening geometry tolerances
   147	blind snapshot regeneration
   148	deleting regression fixtures
   149	ignoring thrown errors
   150	changing expected values merely to match current implementation
   151	@ts-nocheck
   152	@ts-ignore
   153	```
   154	
   155	Existing regression tests are historical evidence.
   156	
   157	Do not remove them casually.
   158	
   159	---
   160	
   161	## 7. Architecture Direction
   162	
   163	Prefer dependency direction:
   164	
   165	```text
   166	UI / Framework
   167	      ↓
   168	Adapters
   169	      ↓
   170	Application / Interaction
   171	      ↓
   172	Domain
   173	      ↓
   174	Pure primitives
   175	```
   176	
   177	Do not solve domain defects inside renderers, React lifecycle hooks, persistence adapters, or framework glue.
   178	
   179	Fix the first incorrect decision in the proper layer.
   180	
   181	---
   182	
   183	## 8. Derived State
   184	
   185	Do not persist state that can be deterministically derived from semantic state unless the specification explicitly requires materialization.
   186	
   187	Typical transient/derived state includes:
   188	
   189	```text
   190	selection handles
   191	preview geometry
   192	render-only paths
   193	cached projections
   194	temporary interaction coordinates
   195	```
   196	
   197	---
   198	
   199	## 9. Determinism
   200	
   201	Core domain algorithms must not depend on accidental runtime state such as:
   202	
   203	```text
   204	Math.random()
   205	Date.now()
   206	DOM ordering
   207	React render ordering
   208	screen zoom
   209	devicePixelRatio
   210	pointer event frequency
   211	animation-frame timing
   212	```
   213	
   214	Identical semantic inputs must produce identical semantic outputs within the explicitly defined numeric tolerance.
   215	
   216	---
   217	
   218	## 10. Scope Discipline
   219	
   220	Do not turn an active OpenSpec change into an unrelated repository-wide refactoring.
   221	
   222	If unrelated technical debt is discovered:
   223	
   224	```text
   225	document it
   226	do not opportunistically implement it
   227	```
   228	
   229	unless it blocks the active change.
   230	
   231	---
   232	
   233	## 11. Evidence
   234	
   235	Never report:
   236	
   237	```text
   238	"should pass"
   239	"looks correct"
   240	"probably fixed"
   241	```
   242	
   243	as verification.
   244	
   245	Claims about passing tests or validation must come from commands that were actually executed.
   246	
   247	At the end of implementation report:
   248	
   249	```text
   250	CHANGE:
   251	IMPLEMENTED:
   252	FILES CHANGED:
   253	TESTS ADDED:
   254	COMMANDS EXECUTED:
   255	TEST RESULTS:
   256	KNOWN BLOCKERS:
   257	READY_FOR_VERIFY: YES | NO
   258	```
   259	
   260	---
   261	
   262	## 12. Architecture Gate
   263	
   264	An Architecture Gate is a review phase.
   265	
   266	During a gate:
   267	
   268	```text
   269	DO NOT MODIFY PRODUCTION CODE
   270	```
   271	
   272	unless the task is explicitly changed from review to repair.
   273	
   274	Gate output must contain exactly one unambiguous status:
   275	
   276	```text
   277	GATE_STATUS: PASS
   278	```
   279	
   280	or:
   281	
   282	```text
   283	GATE_STATUS: FAIL
   284	```
   285	
   286	Correctness or architecture blockers always mean `FAIL`.
   287	
   288	---
   289	
   290	## 13. No Autonomous Phase Advancement
   291	
   292	Do not automatically start the next numbered OpenSpec change after completing the current one.
   293	
   294	Example:
   295	
   296	```text
   297	R04 complete
   298	→ STOP
   299	→ report status
   300	```
   301	
   302	Do not automatically begin R05.
   303	
   304	Each numbered change is an engineering checkpoint.
   305	
   306	---
   307	
   308	## 14. Routing Engine V2
   309	
   310	Any task involving:
   311	
   312	```text
   313	edge routing
   314	edge connections
   315	terminal attachment
   316	waypoints
   317	orthogonal routing
   318	segment editing
   319	routing preview
   320	self-loops
   321	routing rendering
   322	routing/X6 integration
   323	```
   324	
   325	must additionally read:
   326	
   327	```text
   328	docs/routing-v2/drawio-routing-master-spec.md
   329	docs/routing-v2/implementation-playbook.md
   330	```
   331	
   332	These documents define the Routing Engine V2 architecture and implementation program.
   333	
   334	When a routing-specific nested `AGENTS.md` exists, its stricter rules also apply.
   335	
   336	Do not implement Routing Engine V2 from memory or from legacy code alone.
   337	
   338	---
   339	
   340	## 15. Routing V2 Sequence
   341	
   342	Routing Engine V2 follows this dependency order:
   343	
   344	```text
   345	R01 Geometry Kernel
   346	 ↓
   347	R02 Terminal / Perimeter
   348	 ↓
   349	R03 Direction Resolver
   350	 ↓
   351	R04 Orthogonal Router
   352	 ↓
   353	R05 Segment Router
   354	 ↓
   355	R06 Segment Editor
   356	 ↓
   357	R07 Preview / Commit
   358	 ↓
   359	R08 Self-loop
   360	 ↓
   361	R09 Draw.io Differential Harness
   362	 ↓
   363	R10 X6 Integration
   364	```
   365	
   366	A later change must not compensate for a defect in an earlier layer.
   367	
   368	Fix the responsible layer.
   369	
   370	---
   371	
   372	## 16. Git Safety
   373	
   374	Do not perform destructive operations merely to simplify implementation.
   375	
   376	Do not execute without explicit instruction:
   377	
   378	```text
   379	git reset --hard
   380	git clean -fd
   381	discard unrelated user changes
   382	rewrite unrelated commits
   383	```
   384	
   385	Before reporting implementation complete, inspect:
   386	
   387	```text
   388	git status
   389	git diff
   390	```
   391	
   392	Unexpected unrelated changes must be identified.
   393	
   394	---
   395	
   396	## 17. Prime Directive
   397	
   398	Do not optimize for:
   399	
   400	```text
   401	"make the current visual symptom disappear"
   402	```
   403	
   404	Optimize for:
   405	
   406	```text
   407	correct domain model
   408	+
   409	explicit invariants
   410	+
   411	deterministic implementation
   412	+
   413	executable regression protection
   414	+
   415	correct architecture boundary
   416	```
   417	
   418	---
   419	
   420	## 18. Independent Feature Ownership and Parallel Work
   421	
   422	The active change is selected for the current task and workspace. A program's
   423	`CURRENT_CHANGE.md`, phase, frozen fingerprints and numbered sequence govern work
   424	in that program; they are not a repository-wide lock on independent features.
   425	Sections 1–17 remain mandatory. A failing applicable check still stops its owner.
   426	
   427	Independent features may proceed in parallel in separate branches/worktrees.
   428	Each has its own approved scope, baseline, PRE, tests, verification, POST and
   429	archive checkpoint. Do not run concurrent writers in the same checkout. Do not
   430	copy another feature's uncommitted source, tests, dependency edits or process
   431	state into a feature workspace. Record the exact transferred files and hashes.
   432	
   433	Declare a directed dependency only when a feature consumes another feature's
   434	API, artifact or behavior. The consumer owns its waiting, integration, adapter,
   435	compatibility tests and control revalidation tasks. The supplier does not wait
   436	for the consumer's gate, completion, archive or process repair. Shared ancestry,
   437	a common package, a dirty checkout or a historical whole-file fingerprint is
   438	not by itself a product dependency.
   439	
   440	Frozen files stay frozen in the owning workspace against its approved baseline.
   441	An independent authorized change to a shared file in another workspace does not
   442	require that frozen feature's approval. When the frozen feature adopts that
   443	change, it must review the resulting control/behavior changes in its own process,

    63	## Transaction, commit point and startup recovery
    64	
    65	Installer serializes operations against one registry revision. Content-addressed version dirs keep exact immutable bytes for current and retained previous versions; one active version per ID.     66	
    67	Phases: STAGING -> VALIDATED -> PREPARED -> SWAPPED -> PRESENTATION_ACK -> COMMITTED -> CLEANUP. Windows file sync/rename limitations are disclosed and failures remain REFUSED/UNKNOWN/BLOCKED, never assumed durable. Do not use two independent journals with inconsistent startup decisions. Recovery validates journal identity/hash/path/phase and uses one coordinator to restore registry and presentation before first paint/window ready.    107	### Root binding and race closure
   108	
   109	Supported first backend: local fixed NTFS on Windows x64 with an existing compatible .NET Framework CLR/compiler. Reject UNC/network, FAT/exFAT/ReFS, unsupported architecture/CLR and ambiguous volume mapping; no automatic fallback. Main binds its dedicated userData/extensions root once for one session/generation; renderer cannot choose root. Selected package input is read by the existing authorized Main picker path and transferred as owned bounded bytes; the helper never opens that external path. Ancestor metadata handles are needed only to establish the authorized root, not to read ancestor files. Test roots are exclusively owned temporary fixtures.
   110	
   111	1. Resolve the drive to its volume GUID, confirm fixed NTFS and store volume identity. Open the volume root directory (not a raw device) and walk each single validated component to the installation root. Each directory open uses NtCreateFile with RootDirectory equal to the already retained parent handle, FILE_DIRECTORY_FILE, FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT and synchronous options, without backup privilege/elevation. Reject empty/dot/dotdot/ADS/device/reserved/ambiguous components, reparse/other special attributes and case-sensitive directory mode. Validate directory type, final volume/name and file identity from the returned handle, never only lstat. Retain each checked handle with FILE_SHARE_READ only, denying write/delete sharing; existing incompatible writer/deleter yields REFUSED before any effect. Missing installation root may be created exclusively relative to a checked parent, then its returned handle validated; missing/untrusted outer ancestors are never created. There is no unlocked check-then-path-open window.
   112	2. Descend below root using only one-component parent-handle-relative opens/creates and retain checked parents until the operation and transaction release boundary. FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT ensures the object itself is examined before traversal; every returned directory is rejected if reparse. Handle-relative addressing prevents changed drive letters or textual ancestor substitutions from selecting another root; retained identities/no-delete sharing prevent replacement. Parent reparse mutation/previous writers must be refused or proven unable to redirect handle-relative operations. Actual adversarial fixtures cover both rename replacement and in-place reparse mutation; a failed race closure is a blocker, never a string-prefix workaround.
   113	3. Create files with FILE_CREATE/CREATE_NEW, non-directory/reparse-open/write-through options, bounded chunk writes and no write/delete sharing. Validate ordinary file, same volume/parent, single hardlink and actual byte count/hash via the held handle; reject existing leaves/reparse/hardlinks/devices/ADS. Read only checked ordinary files via held handles with bounded actual counts; reject changed installed content. Native ABI layouts use pointer-size-correct offsets and checked NTSTATUS/Win32 return values. No suppressed error, buffer overflow or unbounded allocation.
   114	4. Renames use the held source handle with DELETE access and SetFileInformationByHandle(FileRenameInfo) targeting a single validated basename relative to the retained target-parent handle. No reopen-by-path, cross-volume copy, delayed reboot, arbitrary rename flags or shell is allowed. Source and target must be same-volume checked ordinary objects; journal replacement is same-directory. Old journal bytes/hash remain in coordinator recovery data. Target conflicts/reparse/special objects fail closed; path replacement of target cannot redirect writes because only its directory entry is replaced, never followed. Do not release root/parents during commit or between staging validation and effect.
   115	5. Cleanup enumerates only held checked directories with bounded entry/count/depth, opens every child itself without following reparses and deletes the opened object by handle. Retain parents, check volume/object identities; do not recursively delete a computed text path. Release source/consumer handles at approved cleanup boundary. Sharing conflicts return CLEANUP_PENDING, never physical-deletion success. Shutdown/EOF/helper death releases OS handles and makes session unusable; new generation must recover before another operation.

   117	### Journal persistence and supported guarantee
   118	
   119	The unchanged transaction contract requires a durable coordinator intent before every side effect and valid COMMITTED marker before ACK. For same-directory journal replacement, create exclusive write-through ordinary temp file, write exact bounded journal bytes and FlushFileBuffers on the held writable handle; rename that same held object relative to the checked parent as above. After rename, make a write-through write of the same exact journal contents on the same held object, FlushFileBuffers again, and verify identity/final name, size and SHA256 before ACK. The post-rename write is idempotent and changes no semantic bytes; a crash before completion is reconciled from validated old/new hashes and phase, never assumed committed. NTFS metadata flushing associated with a write-through write is the selected documented OS mechanism; generic rename return or Node fsync(directory) is not our mechanism.
   120	
   121	Supported claim is checked Windows/NTFS write-through + explicit file flush and same-directory handle rename, with process-crash recovery proved by real kill/reopen at all phases/effects. Full OS/storage power-loss behavior is NOT_PROVEN; do not advertise unconditional hardware durability. No raw-volume flush requiring admin and no synthetic directory-sync success. This is an API-level persistence guarantee subject to OS/storage honoring flush/write-through; report the exact capability/preconditions. If the runtime cannot prove these calls/identity/race semantics in its owned capability fixture, it returns BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE/REFUSED before installer use. If an error, timeout or helper death occurs after any effect but before durable ACK, return UNKNOWN, preserve old/new bytes, block new transactions and reconcile through startup journal; never report successful install. If stronger unconditional power-loss proof is later required, stop for its own explicit decision rather than weakening this contract.

   123	### Closed transport, limits and lifecycle
   124	
   125	No shell: spawn the verified helper directly with hidden window and dedicated stdio; no network, commands, executable package loading or generic host paths. Main chooses root and host-generated session/generation. One bind request, then version1 closed operations bind/capabilities/mkdir/read/write-open/write-chunk/write-close/replace/list/remove/dispose; operation-specific exact schemas reject unknown fields. Helper returns opaque internal handle IDs bound to session/generation, never OS handles to renderer. Frames are newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON max128KiB, chunks max64KiB decoded (strict base64), paths max4096 characters/depth32, directory entries10000, per-file/aggregate bytes no greater than unchanged archive50MiB/200MiB; actual writes/counts and buffers are bounded. State schema/journal metadata max1MiB; larger archive transfer is chunked, not one giant JSON. Validate version, monotonically increasing unique requestID, session, generation, operation, sequence, expected offset, deadline and exact field types before effect. Serialize one pending command; duplicate/replayed/out-of-order/expired frames terminate/refuse the session without another effect. No unbounded queues. Use host monotonic deadlines (10s bind/operation, bounded long writes per chunk); replies bind exact request/session/generation. Wrong, malformed, oversized, timed-out or late responses fail closed. Host transport kills/disposes an unusable helper, rejects pending calls and marks UNKNOWN if an effect may have happened; retries are coordinator recovery decisions, never blind repeats. EOF/close/dispose/window lifecycle invalidates all outstanding handles and subscriptions. Tests separately prove wrong-session/generation/deadline/frame/offset/replay, crashes before/after effect and actual handle release.

    63	## Transaction, commit point and startup recovery
    64	
    65	Installer serializes operations against one registry revision. Content-addressed version dirs keep exact immutable bytes for current and retained previous versions; one active version per ID. Journal contains bounded validated transactionID, old/new registry snapshots, exact package hashes/version locations, old/new durable presentation records, phase and cleanup tasks. Package storage/journal is separate from repository journals and workspace.
    66	
    67	Phases: STAGING -> VALIDATED -> PREPARED -> SWAPPED -> PRESENTATION_ACK -> COMMITTED -> CLEANUP. Persist each intent before its side effect with file sync and atomic same-directory replace; acknowledge commits only after durable committed marker and consistent registry/presentation. Windows file sync/rename limitations are disclosed and failures remain REFUSED/UNKNOWN/BLOCKED, never assumed durable. Do not use two independent journals with inconsistent startup decisions. Recovery validates journal identity/hash/path/phase and uses one coordinator to restore registry and presentation before first paint/window ready. Corrupt/ambiguous journal is RECOVERY_BLOCKED with recoverable old bytes preserved, not silent reset.
    68	
    69	- Before swap, validate and prepare registrations/fallback/consumer quiescence. Cancel pending preview through existing P01 transaction; synchronize renderer membership and generation without killing/recreating document editors. Active affected-theme update, disable, uninstall or rollback prepares P01 participants and replacement selection; package install that does not affect an already selected theme leaves selection/snapshot/settings bytes unchanged.
    70	- Publish new registry revision only with ready candidate registrations and P01 prepared participant acknowledgements. Keep neutral existing P01 barrier until renderer/Main settings and committed installer generation agree. Failure before COMMITTED restores old registry/version/registrations plus prior durable presentation, quiescence and selection; old package bytes retained. Late/duplicate ACKs never commit another transaction. Failure/UNKNOWN reconciliation blocks new lifecycle operations; explicit recovery restores last committed state.
    71	- Crash before valid COMMITTED marker rolls back both registry/presentation to old; crash after valid marker retains new and resumes cleanup. Test interruption after each durable phase and each side effect, including gap between registry swap and presentation persistence, committed marker and replies, and missing retained files. Reopen a fresh loader over actual temp filesystem; separately execute killed-process recovery fixtures rather than treating thrown exceptions as real crash evidence.
    72	- Explicit retained-version rollback uses actual stored bytes and compatibility validation. If prior bytes are absent/changed, return unavailable diagnostic and keep current, not magic recreation. Concurrent operations use expected revision and serialized queue; delete/update races reject stale requests without duplicate active versions.

   106	
   107	### Root binding and race closure
   108	
   109	Supported first backend: local fixed NTFS on Windows x64 with an existing compatible .NET Framework CLR/compiler. Reject UNC/network, FAT/exFAT/ReFS, unsupported architecture/CLR and ambiguous volume mapping; no automatic fallback. Main binds its dedicated userData/extensions root once for one session/generation; renderer cannot choose root. Selected package input is read by the existing authorized Main picker path and transferred as owned bounded bytes; the helper never opens that external path. Ancestor metadata handles are needed only to establish the authorized root, not to read ancestor files. Test roots are exclusively owned temporary fixtures.
   110	
   111	1. Resolve the drive to its volume GUID, confirm fixed NTFS and store volume identity. Open the volume root directory (not a raw device) and walk each single validated component to the installation root. Each directory open uses NtCreateFile with RootDirectory equal to the already retained parent handle, FILE_DIRECTORY_FILE, FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT and synchronous options, without backup privilege/elevation. Reject empty/dot/dotdot/ADS/device/reserved/ambiguous components, reparse/other special attributes and case-sensitive directory mode. Validate directory type, final volume/name and file identity from the returned handle, never only lstat. Retain each checked handle with FILE_SHARE_READ only, denying write/delete sharing; existing incompatible writer/deleter yields REFUSED before any effect. Missing installation root may be created exclusively relative to a checked parent, then its returned handle validated; missing/untrusted outer ancestors are never created. There is no unlocked check-then-path-open window.
   112	2. Descend below root using only one-component parent-handle-relative opens/creates and retain checked parents until the operation and transaction release boundary. FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT ensures the object itself is examined before traversal; every returned directory is rejected if reparse. Handle-relative addressing prevents changed drive letters or textual ancestor substitutions from selecting another root; retained identities/no-delete sharing prevent replacement. Parent reparse mutation/previous writers must be refused or proven unable to redirect handle-relative operations. Actual adversarial fixtures cover both rename replacement and in-place reparse mutation; a failed race closure is a blocker, never a string-prefix workaround.
   113	3. Create files with FILE_CREATE/CREATE_NEW, non-directory/reparse-open/write-through options, bounded chunk writes and no write/delete sharing. Validate ordinary file, same volume/parent, single hardlink and actual byte count/hash via the held handle; reject existing leaves/reparse/hardlinks/devices/ADS. Read only checked ordinary files via held handles with bounded actual counts; reject changed installed content. Native ABI layouts use pointer-size-correct offsets and checked NTSTATUS/Win32 return values. No suppressed error, buffer overflow or unbounded allocation.
   114	4. Renames use the held source handle with DELETE access and SetFileInformationByHandle(FileRenameInfo) targeting a single validated basename relative to the retained target-parent handle. No reopen-by-path, cross-volume copy, delayed reboot, arbitrary rename flags or shell is allowed. Source and target must be same-volume checked ordinary objects; journal replacement is same-directory. Old journal bytes/hash remain in coordinator recovery data. Target conflicts/reparse/special objects fail closed; path replacement of target cannot redirect writes because only its directory entry is replaced, never followed.    116	
   117	### Journal persistence and supported guarantee
   118	
   119	The unchanged transaction contract requires a durable coordinator intent before every side effect and valid COMMITTED marker before ACK. For same-directory journal replacement, create exclusive write-through ordinary temp file, write exact bounded journal bytes and FlushFileBuffers on the held writable handle; rename that same held object relative to the checked parent as above. After rename, make a write-through write of the same exact journal contents on the same held object, FlushFileBuffers again, and verify identity/final name, size and SHA256 before ACK. The post-rename write is idempotent and changes no semantic bytes; a crash before completion is reconciled from validated old/new hashes and phase, never assumed committed. NTFS metadata flushing associated with a write-through write is the selected documented OS mechanism; generic rename return or Node fsync(directory) is not our mechanism.
   120	
   121	Supported claim is checked Windows/NTFS write-through + explicit file flush and same-directory handle rename, with process-crash recovery proved by real kill/reopen at all phases/effects. Full OS/storage power-loss behavior is NOT_PROVEN; do not advertise unconditional hardware durability. No raw-volume flush requiring admin and no synthetic directory-sync success. This is an API-level persistence guarantee subject to OS/storage honoring flush/write-through; report the exact capability/preconditions. If the runtime cannot prove these calls/identity/race semantics in its owned capability fixture, it returns BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE/REFUSED before installer use. If an error, timeout or helper death occurs after any effect but before durable ACK, return UNKNOWN, preserve old/new bytes, block new transactions and reconcile through startup journal; never report successful install. If stronger unconditional power-loss proof is later required, stop for its own explicit decision rather than weakening this contract.
   122	
   123	### Closed transport, limits and lifecycle
   124	
   125	No shell: spawn the verified helper directly with hidden window and dedicated stdio; no network, commands, executable package loading or generic host paths. Main chooses root and host-generated session/generation. One bind request, then version1 closed operations bind/capabilities/mkdir/read/write-open/write-chunk/write-close/replace/list/remove/dispose; operation-specific exact schemas reject unknown fields. Helper returns opaque internal handle IDs bound to session/generation, never OS handles to renderer. Frames are newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON max128KiB, chunks max64KiB decoded (strict base64), paths max4096 characters/depth32, directory entries10000, per-file/aggregate bytes no greater than unchanged archive50MiB/200MiB; actual writes/counts and buffers are bounded. State schema/journal metadata max1MiB; larger archive transfer is chunked, not one giant JSON. Validate version, monotonically increasing unique requestID, session, generation, operation, sequence, expected offset, deadline and exact field types before effect. Serialize one pending command; duplicate/replayed/out-of-order/expired frames terminate/refuse the session without another effect. No unbounded queues. Use host monotonic deadlines (10s bind/operation, bounded long writes per chunk); replies bind exact request/session/generation. Wrong, malformed, oversized, timed-out or late responses fail closed. Host transport kills/disposes an unusable helper, rejects pending calls and marks UNKNOWN if an effect may have happened; retries are coordinator recovery decisions, never blind repeats. EOF/close/dispose/window lifecycle invalidates all outstanding handles and subscriptions. Tests separately prove wrong-session/generation/deadline/frame/offset/replay, crashes before/after effect and actual handle release.

Update coherent active P02 plan/spec/tasks without erasing original requirements/evidence; strict validation; fresh independent PRE on approved gpt-6-sol/xhigh covering this backend amendment and existing component/control state. No backend implementation before PRE PASS. Then meaningful RED, implementation, required tests, actual build/runtime/crash evidence, full verify/POST/visual/archive. STOP beforeP03. Current archive component59/59/typecheck/lint/UIcompliance/strict PASS remains historical component evidence only; all remaining gates remain required.
    41	
    42	## Primary technical references checked10October2026
    43	
    44	- [CreateFileW](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/fileapi/nf-fileapi-createfilew): reparse-point opening and sharing options. A final-component open flag alone is not an ancestor confinement algorithm.
    45	- [MoveFileExW](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/windows/win32/api/winbase/nf-winbase-movefileexw): same-volume replace/write-through options and error behavior; assess exact supported guarantees without overstating generic crash/power-loss evidence.
    46	
    47	These API references are candidates for the backend design, not implementation or capability proof.

1	# Frade common agent workflow — v1.1
     2	
     3	These mandatory rules apply to every engineering branch/worktree of this Frade repository. The user's 1 October 2026 instruction authorizes automatic independent OpenAI Codex review of relevant Frade sources, contracts, tests and evidence. Credentials, secrets, global settings and other repositories are excluded. Existing AGENTS, approved OpenSpec scope, STOP conditions, test integrity, frozen controls and each numbered checkpoint remain mandatory.
     4	
     5	## Automatic PRE and POST
     6	
     7	The owning agent reads its approved branch plan, selects the exact model and reasoning effort assigned to the current stage and PRE/POST review role, prepares the relevant packet/prompt, invokes a fresh independent reviewer and receives the result without human relay or repeated review approval. There is no universal model/effort default, silent upgrade or downgrade. Do not reuse implementation or fix-worker parameters for a review unless that role is explicitly assigned in the plan. Missing, ambiguous or conflicting assignment, unavailable required model/effort or unverified sandbox is BLOCKED for the actual decision/limitation. Record the stage, role and exact selected plan path/hash/excerpt. Requested model/effort and independently attested backend/effort are separate; actual backend/effort remains NOT_CONFIRMED.
     8	
     9	Use this order: approved coherent proposal/design/spec/tasks → actual strict validation → independent PRE PASS → BDD / meaningful RED → implementation → required GREEN/general checks → OpenSpec verify → independent POST PASS → archive/checkpoint. Preserve stricter program gates and original origin. A focused PASS does not close cumulative work, grant visual acceptance, waive a failed test or authorize the next numbered change. A machine gate is not independent approval. FAIL stops its scope. Human decisions are required for material scope/spec/visual/destination or unresolved authorization/environment changes, not for passing prompts/results.
    10	
    11	The reviewer receives an immutable minimal explicit packet. Missing relevant inputs are a completeness blocker. The authenticated external harness uses the signed-in account; auth is not copied or readable by reviewer commands. The pinned current-host runtime is Codex CLI 0.159.3 under WSL Ubuntu-22.04_E. Each invocation first runs an offline sandbox canary: packet read allowed; candidate, Git common storage, another worktree, auth/config reads denied; file writes and socket access denied. Network/apps/web/shell inheritance are disabled inside commands. Root deny with minimal public tools and explicit runtime read is mandatory, not just a read-only label.
    12	
    13	Generated instances also use `--ignore-user-config`, `--ignore-rules`, `project_doc_max_bytes=0`, `project_doc_fallback_filenames=[]`. Relevant AGENTS are selected explicitly in the packet. These suppress automatic AGENTS/rules/user-config loading; they do not remove platform instructions or built-in tool descriptions. Do not claim an unattested absence of all platform context. Credentials remain outside sandbox in the launcher. Missing or failed confinement/version proof is BLOCKED; no Windows fallback with weaker isolation.
    14	
    15	## Shared service discovery
    16	
    17	One installation lives in the repository's **Git common directory**, not a feature branch. `frade-workflow/current.json` points to an immutable content-hash release. It contains reviewed public policy, CLI and exact transport templates, no account configuration. No per-branch reviewer/model setup is needed. Each run derives the owning root/branch from actual cwd, verifies registration against this original Frade common directory, rejects unrelated repositories even if origin matches, and uses a unique run directory. Never run concurrent feature writers in one checkout.
    18	
    19	From any registered Frade worktree, in PowerShell:
    20	
    21	```powershell
    22	$fradeCommon = (git rev-parse --path-format=absolute --git-common-dir).Trim()
    23	$fradePointer = Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fradeCommon 'frade-workflow/current.json') -Raw | ConvertFrom-Json
    24	$fradeRelease = Join-Path $fradeCommon ("frade-workflow/releases/" + $fradePointer.release)
    25	$fradeRunner = Join-Path $fradeRelease 'scripts/agent-review/cli.mjs'
    26	node $fradeRunner status
    27	Get-Content -LiteralPath (Join-Path $fradeRelease 'docs/engineering/agent-workflow.md') -Raw
    28	```
    29	
    30	`status` verifies every public bundle file before reporting AVAILABLE. The pointer digest must equal the verified returned release digest. If missing/drifted, stop and report BLOCKED; never fall back to a different repository/worktree. Older branch files and already-running chats cannot be silently rewritten/reinstructed. Load this shared policy through the one-time owner handoff; adopt tracked rules through that branch's approved control process. Future branches acquire root rules by adopting the process commit. No full UI merge is necessary.
    31	
    32	## Packet and owner adoption
    33	
    34	Before freeze, the owner selects root/scoped AGENTS, active artifacts, applicable contracts, source/tests/evidence and actual check records. Never send .git, .env, credential files, global settings or another repository. Secret/path guards, safe relative paths and raw file realpath checks are mandatory. Index must be empty; commit the authorized planning checkpoint when required, not by discarding/stashing unrelated work.
    35	
    36	An older branch saves exact reviewed public policy and necessary public controls from the shared release into its **own approved process evidence directory**, records release/version/origin/bytes/hashes, and selects those adopted relative paths. The runner requires a `policyArtifact` selected in `paths`, with bytes matching the shared policy SHA. This is task evidence, not per-branch model/account configuration. The supplier does not write active foreign checkouts. The consumer owns adoption/control compatibility revalidation, preserves its frozen origin and historical FAIL, and never broadens an allowlist or moves baseline silently.
    37	
    38	Select canonical CLI model ID and one exact effort from the approved plan; preserve plan naming/aliases in the exact source excerpt and make the mapping reviewable. The runner verifies safe ID/effort, phase, selected source raw SHA256 and excerpt; the owner and independent reviewer verify semantic approval and conflicts using complete relevant plan inputs. Request metadata is never its own approval. Original v3 templates retain historic constants only as immutable substitution origins. New generated CLI, probe policy, inner metadata and strict outer receipt must match the selected pair exactly.
    39	
    40	Prepare an external JSON request as task input (not inside the frozen candidate). This illustrative Sol/high pair belongs only to the example stage; replace every value from the actual approved stage assignment:
    41	
    42	```json
    43	{
    44	  "phase": "PRE",
    45	  "change": "selected-owning-change",
    46	  "scope": "Exact approved scope and exclusions",
    47	  "reviewPolicy": {
    48	    "stage": "example-stage",
    49	    "phase": "PRE",
    50	    "model": "gpt-6-sol",
    51	    "reasoningEffort": "high",
    52	    "source": {
    53	      "path": "openspec/changes/selected-owning-change/design.md",
    54	      "sha256": "<lowercase SHA256 of raw plan bytes>",
    55	      "excerpt": "<exact approved stage reviewer assignment from the plan>"
    56	    }
    57	  },
    58	  "policyArtifact": "openspec/changes/selected-owning-change/evidence/shared-policy.md",
    59	  "paths": ["AGENTS.md", "openspec/changes/selected-owning-change/design.md", "openspec/changes/selected-owning-change/evidence/shared-policy.md"],
    60	  "prompt": "Full prepared independent review prompt; list authority, scope, applicability, actual evidence, limits and require exactly one standalone GATE_STATUS: PASS or FAIL."
    61	}
    62	```
    63	
    64	The paths and placeholder hash/excerpt above only illustrate shape; the owner must include all necessary relevant inputs. Invoke and receive automatically:
    65	
    66	```powershell
    67	node $fradeRunner probe C:/path/to/external-request.json
    68	node $fradeRunner run C:/path/to/external-request.json
    69	```
    70	
    71	Old requests without an explicit valid reviewPolicy fail BLOCKED; status reports that plan selection is required, not a configured reviewer pair. A probe uses the same explicit selection and never chooses a reviewer default. The previously delivered Routing handoff remains unchanged at the user's request; this v1.1 rule supersedes only its obsolete universal Astra/xhigh wording. The Routing owner already received the direct correction and retains its control/adoption gates.
    72	
    73	The runner preserves full input selection, request/prompt, source/packet/instance hashes, full tracked and nonignored-untracked candidate bytes plus Git identity, stdout/stderr/exit/report and immutable receipt in its unique common run. Do not update sources, dashboards, index or HEAD during review. A changed candidate/request/packet/toolchain/release, failed execution, incomplete stream or ambiguous verdict is BLOCKED. Only a clean completed stream and one exact single-line verdict may authorize progression. The strict outer receipt overrides a permissive inner v3 result. Raw FAIL is never rewritten. Save the received outputs and provenance in dated owning evidence after unfreeze. Exit0=PASS, exit1=FAIL, exit2=BLOCKED; inspect receipt, not an isolated plausible sentence.
    74	
    75	## Required branch progress
    76	
    77	Every active engineering branch MUST maintain its own **tracked `*-STATUS.md`**. Retain existing program files: UI uses `docs/ui/UI-DESIGN-CONTRACT-STATUS.md`, Routing uses `docs/routing-v2/ROUTING-V2-STATUS.md`; otherwise use `docs/engineering/BRANCH-STATUS.md`. Do not create a shared feature-progress file in common storage.
    78	
    79	Include actual branch/worktree, active change, original baseline/cumulative origin and current checkpoint, phase, full stage list plus detailed active tasks, actual check/gate PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED/NOT_RUN, evidence/limitations, unresolved decisions/blockers, next action and commit/push state. Use UTC timestamps for evidence, optional MSK display.
    80	
    81	The owner refreshes on start/resume, accepted scope, completed/blocked tasks, completed check batch, PRE/POST receipt, blocker/visual decision, verify, archive, commit and verified publication. Defer dashboard writes while candidate is frozen. Open the file in the right panel; queued is not proof of visibility. Dashboard is a current projection, never approval/evidence replacement. Preserve historical dated evidence unchanged.
    82	
    83	## Checkpoints and parallel features
    84	
    85	Commit completed authorized checkpoints honestly, including explicitly incomplete FAIL checkpoints. Push only to a user-authorized remote/ref, verify actual remote SHA, never force or rewrite unrelated work. Publishing a UI checkpoint does not authorize publishing another branch. Serialize shared-file merges and explain conflicts.
    86	
    87	UI and Routing have independent feature gates. A directed product dependency exists only when a consumer uses supplier API/artifact/behavior. The consumer owns integration/waiting/adoption; the supplier does not wait for its gate/archive/process repair. Common ancestry, root AGENTS or a historical whole-file fingerprint is not itself a product dependency. If presentation actually changes routing semantics, split it into Routing-owned work.
    88	
    89	## Installation and limitations
    90	
    91	Publish a reviewed public release only after supplier verification and independent POST PASS. `publish` checks original POST transport fingerprints, strict output, packet hashes and every selected release file; it never copies product sources. Save install/pointer/hash/primary-loader provenance and check discovery/confinement from both worktree contexts. Older active owner checkouts are not edited here. Other hosts need one verified runtime installation; unsupported hosts report BLOCKED. These engineering instructions are not GitHub branch protection or CI enforcement.
    92	
    93	Official config references: [configuration](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/config-file/config-reference), [AGENTS discovery](https://learn.chatgpt.com/docs/agent-configuration/agents-md). Executed local probes, not documentation alone, establish current-host command confinement.

item.text: Принятые решения и design согласованы по области: поправка разрешает только helper и перечисленные порты, сборку и проверки; прежний PRE относится к более раннему плану. Сейчас проверяю два места с наибольшим риском: удержание Windows handle при подмене предка и доказуемость ACK журнала после rename.

+
+### Root binding and race closure
+
+Supported first backend: local fixed NTFS on Windows x64 with an existing compatible .NET Framework CLR/compiler. Reject UNC/network, FAT/exFAT/ReFS, unsupported architecture/CLR and ambiguous volume mapping; no automatic fallback. Main binds its dedicated userData/extensions root once for one session/generation; renderer cannot choose root. Selected package input is read by the existing authorized Main picker path and transferred as owned bounded bytes; the helper never opens that external path. Ancestor metadata handles are needed only to establish the authorized root, not to read ancestor files. Test roots are exclusively owned temporary fixtures.
+
+1. Resolve the drive to its volume GUID, confirm fixed NTFS and store volume identity. Open the volume root directory (not a raw device) and walk each single validated component to the installation root. Each directory open uses NtCreateFile with RootDirectory equal to the already retained parent handle, FILE_DIRECTORY_FILE, FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT and synchronous options, without backup privilege/elevation. Reject empty/dot/dotdot/ADS/device/reserved/ambiguous components, reparse/other special attributes and case-sensitive directory mode. Validate directory type, final volume/name and file identity from the returned handle, never only lstat. Retain each checked handle with FILE_SHARE_READ only, denying write/delete sharing; existing incompatible writer/deleter yields REFUSED before any effect. Missing installation root may be created exclusively relative to a checked parent, then its returned handle validated; missing/untrusted outer ancestors are never created. There is no unlocked check-then-path-open window.
+2. Descend below root using only one-component parent-handle-relative opens/creates and retain checked parents until the operation and transaction release boundary. FILE_OPEN_REPARSE_POINT ensures the object itself is examined before traversal; every returned directory is rejected if reparse. Handle-relative addressing prevents changed drive letters or textual ancestor substitutions from selecting another root; retained identities/no-delete sharing prevent replacement. Parent reparse mutation/previous writers must be refused or proven unable to redirect handle-relative operations. Actual adversarial fixtures cover both rename replacement and in-place reparse mutation; a failed race closure is a blocker, never a string-prefix workaround.
+3. Create files with FILE_CREATE/CREATE_NEW, non-directory/reparse-open/write-through options, bounded chunk writes and no write/delete sharing. Validate ordinary file, same volume/parent, single hardlink and actual byte count/hash via the held handle; reject existing leaves/reparse/hardlinks/devices/ADS. Read only checked ordinary files via held handles with bounded actual counts; reject changed installed content. Native ABI layouts use pointer-size-correct offsets and checked NTSTATUS/Win32 return values. No suppressed error, buffer overflow or unbounded allocation.
+4. Renames use the held source handle with DELETE access and SetFileInformationByHandle(FileRenameInfo) targeting a single validated basename relative to the retained target-parent handle. No reopen-by-path, cross-volume copy, delayed reboot, arbitrary rename flags or shell is allowed. Source and target must be same-volume checked ordinary objects; journal replacement is same-directory. Old journal bytes/hash remain in coordinator recovery data. Target conflicts/reparse/special objects fail closed; path replacement of target cannot redirect writes because only its directory entry is replaced, never followed. Do not release root/parents during commit or between staging validation and effect.
+5. Cleanup enumerates only held checked directories with bounded entry/count/depth, opens every child itself without following reparses and deletes the opened object by handle. Retain parents, check volume/object identities; do not recursively delete a computed text path. Release source/consumer handles at approved cleanup boundary. Sharing conflicts return CLEANUP_PENDING, never physical-deletion success. Shutdown/EOF/helper death releases OS handles and makes session unusable; new generation must recover before another operation.
+
+### Journal persistence and supported guarantee
+
+The unchanged transaction contract requires a durable coordinator intent before every side effect and valid COMMITTED marker before ACK. For same-directory journal replacement, create exclusive write-through ordinary temp file, write exact bounded journal bytes and FlushFileBuffers on the held writable handle; rename that same held object relative to the checked parent as above. After rename, make a write-through write of the same exact journal contents on the same held object, FlushFileBuffers again, and verify identity/final name, size and SHA256 before ACK. The post-rename write is idempotent and changes no semantic bytes; a crash before completion is reconciled from validated old/new hashes and phase, never assumed committed. NTFS metadata flushing associated with a write-through write is the selected documented OS mechanism; generic rename return or Node fsync(directory) is not our mechanism.
+
+Supported claim is checked Windows/NTFS write-through + explicit file flush and same-directory handle rename, with process-crash recovery proved by real kill/reopen at all phases/effects. Full OS/storage power-loss behavior is NOT_PROVEN; do not advertise unconditional hardware durability. No raw-volume flush requiring admin and no synthetic directory-sync success. This is an API-level persistence guarantee subject to OS/storage honoring flush/write-through; report the exact capability/preconditions. If the runtime cannot prove these calls/identity/race semantics in its owned capability fixture, it returns BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE/REFUSED before installer use. If an error, timeout or helper death occurs after any effect but before durable ACK, return UNKNOWN, preserve old/new bytes, block new transactions and reconcile through startup journal; never report successful install. If stronger unconditional power-loss proof is later required, stop for its own explicit decision rather than weakening this contract.
+
+### Closed transport, limits and lifecycle
+
+No shell: spawn the verified helper directly with hidden window and dedicated stdio; no network, commands, executable package loading or generic host paths. Main chooses root and host-generated session/generation. One bind request, then version1 closed operations bind/capabilities/mkdir/read/write-open/write-chunk/write-close/replace/list/remove/dispose; operation-specific exact schemas reject unknown fields. Helper returns opaque internal handle IDs bound to session/generation, never OS handles to renderer. Frames are newline-delimited UTF-8 JSON max128KiB, chunks max64KiB decoded (strict base64), paths max4096 characters/depth32, directory entries10000, per-file/aggregate bytes no greater than unchanged archive50MiB/200MiB; actual writes/counts and buffers are bounded. State schema/journal metadata max1MiB; larger archive transfer is chunked, not one giant JSON. Validate version, monotonically increasing unique requestID, session, generation, operation, sequence, expected offset, deadline and exact field types before effect. Serialize one pending command; duplicate/replayed/out-of-order/expired frames terminate/refuse the session without another effect. No unbounded queues. Use host monotonic deadlines (10s bind/operation, bounded long writes per chunk); replies bind exact request/session/generation. Wrong, malformed, oversized, timed-out or late responses fail closed. Host transport kills/disposes an unusable helper, rejects pending calls and marks UNKNOWN if an effect may have happened; retries are coordinator recovery decisions, never blind repeats. EOF/close/dispose/window lifecycle invalidates all outstanding handles and subscriptions. Tests separately prove wrong-session/generation/deadline/frame/offset/replay, crashes before/after effect and actual handle release.
+
+### Build, output and integrity
+
+Discover existing Framework64/v4.0.30319/csc.exe under the OS Windows directory for x64, record its actual version/file hash and compiler/CLR availability; no download, global PATH/config or runtime compilation. Build windows-filesystem.cs with explicit /nologo /target:exe /platform:x64 /optimize+ /warnaserror+ plus necessary framework-only references. Source/protocol/compiler command and produced executable SHA256 are recorded in ignored generated output and immutable check evidence. Integrity is not signing/publisher trust. Copy helper and exact generated integrity metadata to apps/desktop/out/main/extension-filesystem/; build/copy rejects stale/missing source/artifact/hash/version. Main verifies metadata/protocol/hash/architecture and capability handshake before use, never searches arbitrary PATH or starts an extension-supplied executable. The trusted Frade distribution/build output is the deployment boundary; hash checking does not promise protection against an attacker replacing the whole application and its checks.
+

Desktop build keeps assets check -> typecheck -> electron-vite build -> build:utility, then helper build/copy after output exists; dev keeps build:utility then builds/copies before electron-vite dev, and start verifies/copies the current built helper before electron launch. Existing utility/vendor/config behavior is unchanged. Non-Windows native build/copy emits explicit NOT_APPLICABLE_HOST with no fabricated artifact/capability; installer reports BACKEND_UNAVAILABLE.    104	## 6. Theme resolver и hot apply
   105	
   106	Порядок разрешения для каждой роли:
   107	1. Built-in полная палитра соответствующего kind.
   108	2. Установленная enabled theme.
   109	3. User глобальные color overrides.
   110	4. User override для конкретного ThemeId.
   111	5. Разрешённые workspace overrides, если пользователь включил их.
   112	
   113	Preview выбирает candidate theme ID, затем применяет соответствующие overlays. Density, layout и editor lifecycle не участвуют в theme resolution. Forced-colors имеет финальный системный mapping поверх всего и не выключается пользовательским theme file.
   114	
   115	`resolve` — чистая функция; строит полный immutable snapshot, валидирует типы и контраст, возвращает issues. У built-in темы все MUST-пары проходят. Внешняя тема с нарушением получает совместимый repaired snapshot: проблемные пары возвращаются к built-in fg/bg своей роли и kind; алгоритм повторяется до отсутствия нарушений. Fixed pair order + максимум 10 проходов; при отсутствии сходимости применяется полная built-in палитра и статус `FALLBACK`, исходные данные не перезаписываются. Итоговый отчёт содержит repaired roles. Недопустимую структуру пакета installer отклоняет целиком.
   116	
   117	Registry разрешает stable ThemeId; ThemeService собирает snapshot; renderer transaction меняет root variables и theme metadata до paint; portals используют тот же root context; X6/SVG/canvas получают snapshot revision через renderer adapter и redraw в той же визуальной транзакции. Нельзя обновить только оболочку и оставить старый canvas. Если адаптер не готов, commit ждёт prepare-all; на отказ rollback previous snapshot. Запись setting происходит только после успешного commit всех участников.
   118	
   119	События: `onWillChangeTheme({previous,candidate,revision})`, `onDidChangeTheme({snapshot})`, `onThemeChangeFailed({reason,revision})`. Обработчики не могут переписать domain data. Подписчик обязан обработать последнее поколение; быстрый выбор A→B→C коммитит C, late result A/B игнорируется. Browser fallback themes грузятся локально до first paint. Failed persistence возвращает предыдущий persistent выбор и понятную ошибку; preview не объявляется сохранённым.
   120	
   121	Целевой performance contract: после загрузки пакета hot apply p95 ≤150 ms на согласованном benchmark workspace и hardware; результат измеряется. Package parsing выполняется вне interaction-critical renderer. Это проектный бюджет, не уже измеренный показатель. GPU effects не применяются ради theme transition.

   148	## 8. Extension lifecycle и транзакции
   149	
   150	Install: `ABSENT → STAGING → VALIDATED → REGISTERED → INSTALLED`. Validation/commit failure → FAILED с очисткой staging; previous installed version сохраняется. Enable: `DISABLED → ENABLED → INACTIVE`; contribution регистрации доступны после enable, code активируется только по событию. Runtime: `INACTIVE → ACTIVATING → ACTIVE → DEACTIVATING → INACTIVE`; activation/crash → FAILED. Disable снимает registrations и завершает host; theme fallback — часть одной транзакции.
   151	
   152	Update: скачать/скопировать в новый versioned dir → validate → compatibility/capability diff → prepare registrations → quiesce old host → swap registry pointer → activate new generation по необходимости → commit. Отказ до swap не меняет old; отказ после swap выполняет rollback snapshot/registrations, восстанавливает old generation. При добавлении capabilities требуется согласие перед их использованием; theme-only package не показывает бессмысленный permissions-dialog.
   153	
   154	Uninstall: unregister → close/convert зависимые extension editors с защитой dirty data → fallback theme/icons → remove installed record → schedule package cleanup. Если extension editor нельзя безопасно сохранить/закрыть, uninstall BLOCKED с конкретным редактором; force removal не является кнопкой по умолчанию. Physical delete выполняется после commit и освобождения handles; Windows locks не оставляют ложный «удалено».
   155	
   156	Install journal хранит transactionId, old/new registry snapshot и phase. После crash loader завершает чистку либо восстанавливает last committed state. Settings с отсутствующим ThemeId используют built-in и diagnostic; extension reinstall MAY восстановить preference, если это явный сохранённый wantedThemeId.
   157	
   158	Archive limits v1: compressed ≤50 MiB, uncompressed ≤200 MiB, entries ≤10 000, expansion ratio ≤100, path depth ≤32. Это исходные engineering limits, изменяемые политикой в разрешённых пределах. Reject absolute paths, `..`, symlinks, case-insensitive duplicates, invalid Windows reserved names, embedded NUL и entries за пределами package root. Hash, validation и staged writes не изменяют workspace repository.

   181	## 10. Electron/web isolation
   182	
   183	Theme data не требует extension host. Для browser plugins: dedicated sandboxed Electron renderer host, contextIsolation on, nodeIntegration off; plugin JS выполняется в Worker, получает schema-checked MessagePort API. Renderer session изолирована от workbench; navigation/window creation запрещены. CSP default-src none, script/worker sources только validated package protocol; direct network запрещена; web-версия применяет тот же worker/broker contract. Не экспортировать electron/Node/fs/process объект в preload.
   184	
   185	Привилегированные операции остаются в main/service broker: scoped repository handles, разрешённые HTTP endpoints, keychain tokens, file picker, разрешённые writes. Capability list для browser runtime: repository.read, repository.proposeWrite, diagrams.edit, network.request (allowlisted origins), secrets.use (handles, не plaintext), notifications.show. Права не следуют из publisher string. Grants привязаны к identity/version policy и workspace trust. Для closed environment registry policy может запрещать исполняемые пакеты целиком.
   186	
   187	Git/native DB adapters, которым нужны OS drivers, — trusted broker/service adapters, отдельно поставляемые и проверяемые. Не включать Node-runtime в общий browser plugin API ради одного adapter. Отдельный процесс сам по себе не является sandbox; если впоследствии вводится Node extension host, его доверительная модель проектируется отдельно. Проверка режима sandbox и IPC отправителей обязательна по Electron security guidance.

   189	## 11. Каталог и корпоративная поставка
   190	
   191	Frade registry имеет provider interface: list/search/details/download/checkUpdates. Источники: локальный каталог, корпоративный HTTPS registry, опционально публичный Frade registry. Package provenance и signature verification при наличии доверенных ключей — отдельные поля; unsigned file installs отображают настоящее происхождение. Нельзя имитировать Verified Publisher.
   192	
   193	Online отсутствие/ошибка не блокируют built-in темы и установленные расширения. Offline install и export profile доступны без сетевых вызовов. Export profile содержит settings + extension IDs/versions/hashes/источники; не содержит secrets и private repo contents. Установка export требует резолва доступных пакетов, не обещает наличие пакета по одному ID.
   194	
   195	Auto-update настраивается profile/policy. Пакеты с новыми capabilities остаются на старой версии до подтверждения. Version rollback использует сохранённую previous version; если её байтов нет, UI показывает невозможность, не обещает magic rollback.

     1	# Theme Core Specification
     2	
     3	## Purpose
     4

    54	### Requirement: Deterministic complete resolution
    55	
    56	Resolution SHALL preserve immutable source data, fill every registered role, apply declared override precedence and validate named contrast pairs. External low-contrast roles SHALL repair deterministically with diagnostics, bounded ten passes and builtin fallback on nonconvergence.

    64	
    65	All required presentation participants SHALL apply one revision without restart. Preview MUST NOT persist. Cancellation or adapter/persistence failure SHALL restore the previous snapshot and settings without losing dirty editors, selections, undo or document bytes. Stale candidate results MUST NOT overwrite newer selection.

Сверяю это с требованием восстановления старой и новой версии после неопределённого исхода, чтобы отделить противоречие контракта от детали реализации.

   148	## 8. Extension lifecycle и транзакции
   149	
   150	Install: `ABSENT → STAGING → VALIDATED → REGISTERED → INSTALLED`. Validation/commit failure → FAILED с очисткой staging; previous installed version сохраняется. Enable: `DISABLED → ENABLED → INACTIVE`; contribution регистрации доступны после enable, code активируется только по событию. Runtime: `INACTIVE → ACTIVATING → ACTIVE → DEACTIVATING → INACTIVE`; activation/crash → FAILED. Disable снимает registrations и завершает host; theme fallback — часть одной транзакции.
   151	
   152	Update: скачать/скопировать в новый versioned dir → validate → compatibility/capability diff → prepare registrations → quiesce old host → swap registry pointer → activate new generation по необходимости → commit. Отказ до swap не меняет old; отказ после swap выполняет rollback snapshot/registrations, восстанавливает old generation. При добавлении capabilities требуется согласие перед их использованием; theme-only package не показывает бессмысленный permissions-dialog.
   153	
   154	Uninstall: unregister → close/convert зависимые extension editors с защитой dirty data → fallback theme/icons → remove installed record → schedule package cleanup. Если extension editor нельзя безопасно сохранить/закрыть, uninstall BLOCKED с конкретным редактором; force removal не является кнопкой по умолчанию. Physical delete выполняется после commit и освобождения handles; Windows locks не оставляют ложный «удалено».
   155	
   156	Install journal хранит transactionId, old/new registry snapshot и phase. После crash loader завершает чистку либо восстанавливает last committed state. Settings с отсутствующим ThemeId используют built-in и diagnostic; extension reinstall MAY восстановить preference, если это явный сохранённый wantedThemeId.
   157	
   158	Archive limits v1: compressed ≤50 MiB, uncompressed ≤200 MiB, entries ≤10 000, expansion ratio ≤100, path depth ≤32. Это исходные engineering limits, изменяемые политикой в разрешённых пределах. Reject absolute paths, `..`, symlinks, case-insensitive duplicates, invalid Windows reserved names, embedded NUL и entries за пределами package root. Hash, validation и staged writes не изменяют workspace repository.
   159	
   160	## 9. Native Frade plugin contributions
   161	
   162	| Contribution | Контракт |
   163	|---|---|
   164	| themes | Данные цветовых ролей; нет code activation. |
   165	| fileIconThemes / productIconThemes | Независимые icon registries, fallback на built-in, sanitization. |
   166	| commands / menus / keybindings | Namespace extensionId; shared command service; понятные labels; конфликт shortcuts показывается. |
   167	| viewsContainers / views | Activity bar/sidebar/panel; общий UI renderer Frade, tree/table data providers. |
   168	| customEditors | Тип документа, lifecycle/dirty/save/undo, безопасное закрытие при disable. |
   169	| configuration | Typed schema, default/scope, localization, миграция без потери настроек. |
   170	| repositoryAdapters | Асинхронный Repository API через broker, versioning/cancellation, совместимость модели. |
   171	| diagramTools | Команды над approved document model; транзакции и undo; не обходят routing contracts. |
   172	| aiProviders | Broker secrets/network/context, cancellation/streaming; явный provider и формат результата. |
   173	| colors | Namespaced color IDs с defaults для каждого kind и контрактом контраста. |
   174	
   175	Для v1 arbitrary DOM/CSS injection в workbench запрещён. Custom UI получает schema-based компоненты общего Frade UI-layer. Если нужны webviews, это отдельный isolated contribution с CSP и message protocol; он не получает access к host DOM. Inspector, menus и notification templates остаются общими.
   176	
   177	API surface: `commands.registerCommand`, `views.registerTreeProvider`, `editors.registerCustomEditor`, `configuration.get/update/onDidChange`, `themes.onDidChange`, `repository.read/proposeChange`, `diagrams.executeTransaction`, `ai.registerProvider`, `context.subscriptions`. Handlers async, DTO schema checked, requestId/cancellationToken/deadline, events revisioned. Returned `Disposable.dispose()` идемпотентен. Plugin deactivate MUST release subscriptions; host принудительно очищает leaks.
   178	
   179	Activation events: onCommand, onView, onEditorType, onRepositoryAdapter, onAIProvider, onStartupFinished. Contribution registry доступен без code activation. Activation timeout v1 — 5 s; request timeout по API; failure не запускает бесконечный restart loop. После crash — explicit retry/disable и logs, editors сохраняют recoverable state.
   180	
   181	## 10. Electron/web isolation
   182	
   183	Theme data не требует extension host. Для browser plugins: dedicated sandboxed Electron renderer host, contextIsolation on, nodeIntegration off; plugin JS выполняется в Worker, получает schema-checked MessagePort API. Renderer session изолирована от workbench; navigation/window creation запрещены. CSP default-src none, script/worker sources только validated package protocol; direct network запрещена; web-версия применяет тот же worker/broker contract. Не экспортировать electron/Node/fs/process объект в preload.
   184	
   185	Привилегированные операции остаются в main/service broker: scoped repository handles, разрешённые HTTP endpoints, keychain tokens, file picker, разрешённые writes. Capability list для browser runtime: repository.read, repository.proposeWrite, diagrams.edit, network.request (allowlisted origins), secrets.use (handles, не plaintext), notifications.show. Права не следуют из publisher string. Grants привязаны к identity/version policy и workspace trust. Для closed environment registry policy может запрещать исполняемые пакеты целиком.
   186	
   187	Git/native DB adapters, которым нужны OS drivers, — trusted broker/service adapters, отдельно поставляемые и проверяемые. Не включать Node-runtime в общий browser plugin API ради одного adapter. Отдельный процесс сам по себе не является sandbox; если впоследствии вводится Node extension host, его доверительная модель проектируется отдельно. Проверка режима sandbox и IPC отправителей обязательна по Electron security guidance.
   188	
   189	## 11. Каталог и корпоративная поставка
   190	
   191	Frade registry имеет provider interface: list/search/details/download/checkUpdates. Источники: локальный каталог, корпоративный HTTPS registry, опционально публичный Frade registry. Package provenance и signature verification при наличии доверенных ключей — отдельные поля; unsigned file installs отображают настоящее происхождение. Нельзя имитировать Verified Publisher.
   192	
   193	Online отсутствие/ошибка не блокируют built-in темы и установленные расширения. Offline install и export profile доступны без сетевых вызовов. Export profile содержит settings + extension IDs/versions/hashes/источники; не содержит secrets и private repo contents. Установка export требует резолва доступных пакетов, не обещает наличие пакета по одному ID.
   194	
   195	Auto-update настраивается profile/policy. Пакеты с новыми capabilities остаются на старой версии до подтверждения. Version rollback использует сохранённую previous version; если её байтов нет, UI показывает невозможность, не обещает magic rollback.
   196	
   197	## 12. Последовательность OpenSpec changes
   198	
   199	| Этап | Результат | Обязательные проверки |
   200	|---|---|---|
   201	| P01 theme core | Registry, resolver, Light/Dark/HC/System, атомарная смена, preview | Unit/property resolver, state-preservation, theme visual matrix |
   202	| P02 declarative installer | `.frade-extension`, schemas, journal, install/update/remove, theme packages | ZIP fixtures, failed transactions, crash recovery, missing IDs |
   203	| P03 VS Code theme adapter | JSONC/VSIX theme-only import, mapping, diagnostics | known mappings, includes/cycles/path escape, unknown/syntax/alpha reports |
   204	| P04 icon registries | File/product icons, fallback, profile settings | SVG validation, missing glyphs, scope disposal, light/dark/HC |
   205	| P05 browser extension host | Worker/broker/DTO/capabilities/lifecycle | Isolation/IPC tests, denial, crash/timeout/disposal/generation |
   206	| P06 native contribution APIs | Commands/views/settings/editors; domain adapters separately | Keyboard, theme inheritance, dirty save/disable, API version |
   207	| P07 registry/profiles/policy | Corporate/offline/public providers, update/rollback/export | Offline, provenance, signatures, grants diff, policy enforcement |
   208	
   209	После каждого: proposal/design/tasks/specs → PRE PASS → implementation → unit/BDD/integration/security/visual применимых частей → POST PASS → verify/archive. Не начинать P05 до готовности transactional P02. P06 domain contributions вводятся по отдельным контрактам Repo Core/Draw/AI. «По максимуму» задаёт полный roadmap; не отменяет последовательные gates.

Блокер PRE — не определён протокол смены фаз журнала. [design.md](/mnt/e/dev/codex/frade/.git/frade-workflow/runs/2026-10-10T04-02-03-960Z-86be960d-d099-44b5-91ff-f48a0b16348f/prepared/packet/openspec/changes/frade-p02-transactional-installer/design.md:114) требует отказа при конфликте целевого имени, а строки 67 и 119 — атомарной замены журнала для последовательных фаз. План не выбирает, заменяется ли существующий файл или создаются отдельные файлы фаз. В первом случае не определены допустимый `ReplaceIfExists`, проверка и удержание целевого объекта и сохранение старых байтов при неопределённом результате; во втором — порядок выбора авторитетной фазы при восстановлении. Без этого нельзя доказать требование [spec.md](/mnt/e/dev/codex/frade/.git/frade-workflow/runs/2026-10-10T04-02-03-960Z-86be960d-d099-44b5-91ff-f48a0b16348f/prepared/packet/openspec/changes/frade-p02-transactional-installer/specs/extension-installer/spec.md:84) о восстановлении без ложного ACK после сбоя rename/flush.

Минимальный ремонт: закрепить в design один конкретный способ публикации фаз, правила для существующего целевого файла и независимое сохранение предыдущего подтверждённого состояния; затем проверить конфликты, reparse, сбой flush и kill/reopen на каждом переходе. Строгая валидация и 59 проверок архивного компонента этот пробел не закрывают. К backend BDD/TDD и реализации по текущей поправке переходить нельзя.
